title: Resort and Destination Fee Table for Guest Folios, All Ashbury Brands
content:
The resort or destination fee that appears on a Guest Folio is a per-room-night amount stated before tax, and each Ashbury brand fixes four things about it: the fee per night stayed, whether the fee bears room tax at the reservation's tax rate, whether no fee is charged on nights paid with points or Free Night Awards, and whether the fee is charged only for nights actually stayed.

| Brand | Fee per room night stayed (before tax) | Fee bears room tax | No fee on nights paid with points or Free Night Awards | Fee charged only for nights actually stayed |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ashbury Express | $0.00 | No | Yes | Yes |
| Ashbury Inn & Suites | $0.00 | No | Yes | Yes |
| Ashbury Hotel | $0.00 | No | Yes | Yes |
| Ashbury Grand | $28.00 | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Ashbury Resort & Spa | $45.00 | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Ashbury Reserve | $55.00 | Yes | Yes | Yes |

## Questions the table answers

**Which brands charge a resort or destination fee at all?** Ashbury Grand ($28.00), Ashbury Resort & Spa ($45.00) and Ashbury Reserve ($55.00). The other three brands carry a fee of $0.00.

**Is tax added to the fee?** At the three brands that charge it, yes: the fee bears room tax at the reservation's tax rate. At the brands whose fee is $0.00 the fee is not taxable.

**Is the fee charged on a night paid with points or a Free Night Award?** No, at every brand.

**Is the fee charged for a night the guest did not stay?** No; at every brand the fee is charged only for nights actually stayed.

Hypothetical illustration: a guest who stays three nights at an Ashbury Reserve, all paid in cash, is charged the fee of $55.00 for each of the three nights, each night's fee bearing room tax at the reservation's tax rate.
